newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MOTOR RACING-BERGER TO MISS BRITISH GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BERGER TO MISS BRITISH GRAND PRIX.

text.p: Formula One driver Gerhard Berger said on Tuesday he was pulling out of this weekend's British Grand Prix because he had not fully recovered from a sinus operation.
Berger, 37, who also missed the last two races in Montreal and Magny Cours following the operation last month, will again be replaced in the Benetton team by fellow Austrian Alexander Wurz.
"I haven't been in my (racing) car for seven weeks. It would make no sense for me to suddenly get into the car for an official training without any previous practice," Berger said.
"I wouldn't stand a chance against the others, who have been testing for many days."
He said doctors had advised him to undergo a physical fitness programme before returning to racing.
Berger, second behind Canada's Jacques Villeneuve in last year's race at Silverstone, will test the Benetton in Monza on Tuesday.
